name: @pipeworx/mcp-jira

tools.name: jira_search
tools.description: Search Jira issues using JQL queries. Returns issue keys, summaries, status, assignee, and priority. Use to find tasks by project, status, assignee, or custom criteria.

jql.description: JQL query (e.g., "project = PROJ AND status = Open ORDER BY created DESC")

tools.name: jira_get_issue
tools.description: Get full details for a Jira issue by key (e.g., 'PROJ-123'). Returns description, status, assignee, priority, comments, attachments, and linked issues.

tools.name: jira_list_projects
tools.description: List all accessible Jira projects. Returns project keys, names, descriptions, and types. Use before searching to discover available projects.

tools.name: jira_get_project
tools.description: Get details for a specific Jira project by key (e.g., 'PROJ') or ID. Returns name, description, lead, issue types, and custom fields.

project_key.description: Project key (e.g., "PROJ") or numeric project ID

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-jira forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the jira pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
